_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: window.dropFiles(files) drops files on the composer: it dispatches a "drop" DragEvent carrying a text/plain File for each [name, content] pair on ".message-input-container"; call it in an eval, e.g. window.dropFiles([["a.txt", "some content"]]). Unsent attachments stay with their conversation. There are two conversations: /c/attachment-first, whose drawer item is [data-conversation-id="{{FIRST_ID}}"], and an archived one whose drawer item is [data-conversation-id="{{SECOND_ID}}"]. The server's answer to uploads (/api/upload) is held back until call "release". Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/attachment-first and wait (up to 30s) for the message input (data-testid "message-input") to be visible. 2. Drop one file, "draft.txt" containing "draft attachment". 3. There should be exactly one uploading attachment (".message-attachment-uploading"). 4. Open the conversations drawer (click button[aria-label="Open conversations"]; it is visible on this phone). 5. Click the "View archived" button, then click the archived conversation's item [data-conversation-id="{{SECOND_ID}}"]. 6. The message input should become hidden, and there must be no ".message-attachment" at all (count 0). 7. Call "release". 8. Open the conversations drawer again the same way, click the "Back to conversations" button, then click [data-conversation-id="{{FIRST_ID}}"]. 9. There should be exactly one ready attachment (".message-attachment-ready"), and the attachment name (".message-attachment-name") should be exactly "draft.txt".
